references.text: And the Lord God said: It is not good for man to be alone. I will make him a helper suitable for him.
Then the man said: This time it is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. She shall be called woman, because she was taken out of man.

God said: Let us make mankind in our image, according to our likeness. They shall rule over the fish in the sea and the birds under heaven, over the livestock, over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.

God blessed them and God said to them: Be fruitful and multiply, fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds under heaven and over every living creature that moves on the earth.
Adam gave his wife the name Eve, because she became the mother of all who live.

What is man that you are mindful of him, or the son of man that you care for him? You made him a little lower than God; with glory and honor you crowned him. You set him over the works of your hands; everything you put under his feet.
Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and gave them the name Man on the day they were created.
